title: CollectionRestoreResponse
description: Outcome of POST /v1/collections/{id}/restore (#358): the collection's lifecycle state after the request. 202 in every accepted case — a restore was submitted, one was already in flight, or the collection needs none (already active).

state.description: Lifecycle state after this call: `restoring` when a restore is in flight (submitted now or earlier), `active`/`archiving` when nothing had to be done.

submission_id.description: The workflow-engine submission id when THIS call submitted the restore; null when one was already in flight or none was needed.
